stemMarkdown: After its price was increased by 50%, an article costs Rs. 5550. What was its price (in Rs.) before the increase?
solutionMarkdown: If the original price is $x$, then $x \times \left(1 + \dfrac{50}{100}\right) = 5550$, so $x = \dfrac{5550 \times 100}{150} = 3700$.
altSolutionMarkdown: The new price is 150% of the old, so the old price is $\dfrac{100}{150}$ of Rs. 5550 $=$ Rs. 3700.
